sources.entry: FileGator - FileGator is a powerful multi-user file manager with a single page front-end. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: FileGator is a free, open-source, self-hosted multi-user web file manager with a single-page front-end for managing files and folders on a server or connected cloud storage.
summary.what_it_does: FileGator manages files and folders in a local repository folder on the server or through other storage adapters. It supports multiple users with different roles, permissions and home folders. Basic operations include copy, move, rename, edit, create, delete, preview, zip, unzip, download and upload. Users can download multiple files or folders at once when allowed. Uploads are chunked and support drag-and-drop, a progress bar, and pause and resume. The README says there is no database requirement.
use_cases: share a folder with team members or family
let students or workers upload files
manage a CDN or website files with multiple people
replace FTP or SFTP with a web interface
manage S3 or other cloud storage in a browser
how_to_run: Open http://localhost:8080 and log in as admin/admin123
notable: Multiple storage adapters (Local, FTP, Amazon S3, Dropbox, DO Spaces, Azure Blob and others via Flysystem)
Multi-user auth with roles and permissions, stored in a JSON file, database or WordPress
Chunked, resumable uploads built with Resumable.js
caveats: Symlinks are not supported by the underlying Flysystem
Too many files in one directory can hurt performance
